summary: Iteration 7 — QRU Design Intelligence™ end-to-end validation (backend + frontend + learning hook). All 11 pytest cases in test_iteration7.py PASS in ~42s (including a real GPT-heavy QC certification loop that added a Design Library reference + Master Asset in one round). Backend: GET /api/design/stats returns {brand_standards:1, design_references:6→8, master_assets:9→11, design_principles:6} ✓; GET /api/design/brand-library returns 5 colors (Royal Purple #35106A verified), 2 typography, 6 templates, plus principles/components/spacing/shield ✓; GET /api/design/design-library returns references list ✓; GET /api/design/master-assets?q=heart correctly narrows results and every returned asset contains 'heart' in title/asset_id/keywords ✓; GET /api/design/design-language returns principles that include a 'Learned' category entry ✓; GET /api/design/recommend-templates?product_type=Poster&audience=Children returns cover_template='Poster Template™', palette='Bright QRU (Gold-forward)', illustration_style='Bold', plus layout/typography/tone/icon_set/brand_elements (with QRU Shield™) ✓; unknown product_type falls back to Master Cover Template™ ✓; unauthenticated requests to /api/design/stats return 401/403 ✓. Learning-hook E2E: POST /api/manufacturing2/assemble on KR-DEMO-003 (Insulin) → Interactive Lesson, POST /{pid}/quality-control, polled /{pid}/pipeline every 5s; certified in ~40s (treasure_standard=true) and /api/design/stats confirmed design_references + master_assets each +1 ✓. Frontend E2E (admin@qru.com): /design-intelligence loads with 4 stat cards + 5 tabs (di-tab-brand/design/assets/language/autonomy). Brand tab shows 5 color swatches, typography, principles, components, templates. Master Assets tab: di-asset-search filters from 12→2 for 'heart'. Design Language tab shows Learned chip. Studio Autonomy tab: di-rec-type=Poster + di-rec-aud=Children + click di-recommend renders di-rec-result grid with all 8 fields (Cover Template Poster Template™, Layout Single Focal, Illustration Bold, Palette Bright QRU (Gold-forward), Typography Outfit rounded, Tone Playful & encouraging, Icon Set QRU Line Icons, Brand Elements QRU Shield™, Brand Footer, Treasure Standard™ Badge). Regression: Mission Control loads, /manufacturing-studio loads with ms-kr-select, learner@qru.com redirected to /learn even when hitting /design-intelligence directly (Consumer Mode lock intact).

critical_code_review_comments: design_intelligence.learn_from_product(): duplicate-principle guard uses {'category':'Learned','principle':{'$regex': ptype}} without escaping ptype. If a future product_type ever contains regex metachars (e.g. '+', '(', '.') the query will error or match unintendedly. Use re.escape(ptype) or a plain equality filter on a normalised field.

routers/design.py has no role guard — /api/design/* is readable by any authenticated user including learner@qru.com (Customer). That's fine for read-only brand data but /api/design/checklist/{pid} also has no role guard; if this later mutates state or exposes internal review data it should be gated to Enterprise roles (Administrator/Executive/Creative Studio Director).

design_intelligence.seed_design_intelligence(): the design_library seed loop iterates approved products but never gates on len limits and never runs after the initial empty-collection check. If a demo KR set gets reseeded later with new Treasure Standard products, they will not backfill because 'if count_documents == 0' short-circuits. Consider making learn_from_product() itself idempotent (it already is per product) and simply invoking it for all approved products on every startup, letting the per-product 'find_one({product_id: pid})' skip existing entries.

design_intelligence.library_stats() hardcodes brand_standards:1 rather than counting db.brand_library.count_documents({'kind':'standards'}). Cheap and wrong once versioning is introduced — recommend counting.

routers/design.py GET /master-assets does a case-insensitive regex on title/keywords/asset_id with no length cap. A very long user-supplied q could DoS the query planner; consider clamping q to e.g. 64 chars and escaping regex metachars.

DesignIntelligence.js: useEffect fires 5 parallel GETs on mount and does not handle rejected promises — a 401 or 500 on any single endpoint leaves the tab silently empty. Add .catch() with a toast or a per-section 'Failed to load' state.
DesignIntelligence.js searchAssets() debounces zero times — every keystroke fires a GET. Add a 250-300ms debounce.
